mapper.insert: INSERT INTO punishment (user_id, type, reason, start_time, end_time, status, admin_id, appeal_status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{reason}, NOW(), #{endTime}, 1, #{adminId}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM punishment WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY start_time DESC
SELECT * FROM punishment WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND (end_time IS NULL OR end_time > NOW())

SELECT p.*, u.username, u.nickname FROM punishment p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.user_id
AND p.status = #{status}
AND u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%')
ORDER BY p.start_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE punishment SET status = 2 WHERE punish_id = #{punishId}
UPDATE punishment SET appeal_status = #{appealStatus}, appeal_result = #{appealResult}, status = CASE WHEN #{appealStatus} = 2 THEN 2 ELSE status END WHERE punish_id = #{punishId}
UPDATE punishment SET status = 3 WHERE status = 1 AND end_time IS NOT NULL AND end_time <= NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM punishment WHERE appeal_status = 1
